page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance within the Enhanced instance family. Powered by an Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids processor running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on an x86_64 architecture, this instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory. This hardware allocation establishes a 1:2 ratio of vCPU to RAM, delivering 2.0 GB of memory per dedicated core. The instance operates on KVM hypervisor infrastructure without discrete graphics processing hardware.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring connection to network block storage for operating system installation and persistent data hosting. Network connectivity is a primary specification for this instance type, offering a baseline network bandwidth of 44 Gbps. The configuration provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating explicit network routing setup for external internet communications.

The combination of 32 dedicated cores and 44 Gbps bandwidth provides high compute and network throughput per instance node. The diskless design avoids local storage costs for workloads that rely on remote storage architectures, though block storage overhead must be factored into deployment cost calculations. Recommended application fits include high-traffic web proxies, media transcode pipelines, distributed compute nodes, continuous integration workers, and stateless microservice clusters.
